blocks.text: You can move credentials discovered via external identity sources (e.g., Active Directory (AD) or Entra ID), that aren't currently in use for privileged consoles, from the Discovered or Managed pages to the Ignored page. The credentials listed on the Ignored page can be moved to the Managed page if you want to use them for privileged consoles.
Ignored credentials provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Improve operational efficiency and compliance by automating credential lifecycle management, providing centralized visibility across AD or Entra ID.
Configure auditability through correlation of privileged credential usage with session activity.

blocks.text: To learn more about Privileged Remote Access (PRA), see Understanding Privileged Remote Access. To set up PRA, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Privileged Remote Access.
On the Ignored page (Zero Trust Browser > Credentials Management > Privileged Credentials > Ignored), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Add a new privileged credential.
Discover credentials from the AD.
Click the Filters icon to display or hide the filters.
Click the Search icon to locate specific information in the table.
Refresh the Ignored page to reflect the most current information.
Filter the information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied. To learn more, see Using Tables.

If you are using a Microtenant, then the Microtenant Ownership Type filter is available. By default, the Configured within Microtenant filter option is applied to show the privileged credentials configured within that specific Microtenant. The options for the filter are based on access type (Global and Configured within Microtenant). The Global option filters the information in the table that is configured within the Default Microtenant. The only available operator for this filter type is Equals.
View a list of all credentials that have been designated as ignored. For each ignored credential, you can see:

Name: The name of the ignored credential. Select the checkbox next to Name to select all credentials, or select the checkboxes of specific credentials to import or move them. You can also import and move individual credentials from the Actions column.
Credential Provider: The credential provider for the ignored credential (e.g., Active Directory, Entra ID, etc.).
Discovered: The date, time, and time zone when the credential was discovered.
Click the Import icon to import an ignored credential.
See instructions.
Select the following options in the Import Privileged Credentials window that appears:
Credential Class: Select a credential class from the drop-down menu.
Credential Pools: Select a credential pool from the drop-down menu.
Click Import.
Click the Delete icon to move the credential to the Discovered page. This action does not delete the credential from the external identity sources.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Go to the Managed page to manage privileged credentials.
Go to the Discovered page to manage credentials that have been discovered from external identity sources.
